verdict.rationale: Shopify's Checkout MCP sets explicit preconditions for complete_checkout: the buyer has reviewed and confirmed the order and a payment credential has been collected. complete_checkout is also restricted to Token-tier agents whose token is granted purchase permission, and requires_escalation forces a handoff to the buyer via continue_url. The UCP spec adds AP2 signed payment mandates cryptographically tied to the cart state. Missing for 10: evidence that Shopify itself enforces buyer confirmation server-side rather than leaving it to agent guidance (trusted agents can complete checkouts directly), explicit Shopify-side documentation of AP2 mandate support beyond the UCP spec, and hands-on corroboration of the checkout/payment approval step.
